id: Community Tree Planting on the Farm Loop-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Community Tree Planting on the Farm Loop
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Come and help us plant the first chapter of the Mangaroa Fruit & Forage walking track.

Thanks to the incredible generosity of our community, and matched support through the Ma Earth Fund, we're excited to begin bringing this vision to life. Over the coming years, our 4km farm loop will become an edible landscape filled with heritage fruit trees, nuts, berries, medicinal plants, and foraging species. A place of abundance, learning, biodiversity, and community for generations to come.

It felt only right that a trail for the community, funded by the community, could also be planted by the community.

Before we get planting, local tree crop legends Hannah Dawson and Eric Cairns will share a few practical tips and some of the wisdom behind heritage fruit trees and long-term orchard establishment. Then we'll roll up our sleeves and begin planting the first section of what we hope becomes one of Mangaroa's most loved spaces.

What to bring:
🥾 Sturdy footwear
🌦 Weather-appropriate clothing
💧 Water bottle
🪏 A spade if you have one

Whether you're sponsoring a tree, curious about the project, or simply keen to spend a morning outdoors doing something worthwhile, we'd love to have you with us.

We will begin at Sat 29th August | 9:30am at the Farm Shop - 98 Whitemans Valley Road.

We'll wrap up around 1:30pm with a classic Mangaroa sausage sizzle, good yarns, and a chance to celebrate the beginning of something special back at the Farm Shop.

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Mangaroa Farms Spring Festival-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Mangaroa Farms Spring Festival
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join us on Saturday 31 October from 10am–3pm for our Spring Festival — a special way to welcome the sun with a day of farm charm. Expect family-friendly activities including live music, kids activities, farm and garden tours, workshops, vendors and more. These events are our biggest day of the year, and certainly a great way to experience the joy of Mangaroa Farms.

More details to come - we look forward to seeing you in Spring.

id: Vegetable Fermentation Workshop-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Vegetable Fermentation Workshop
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farm and Hella Coenen for this hands-on vegetable fermentation workshop where you'll learn the art of making small quantities of different krauts at home, followed by a shared meal together.

This is a practical, get-your-hands-dirty kind of day where you'll discover the simple magic of fermentation and take home the skills to keep your kai alive with good bacteria.

You'll make and take home 3 different jars of vegetables to ferment at home, enjoy a shared meal where you can taste a variety of krauts, kombucha and sourdough bread, and be provided with starters, a detailed handout and recipes to continue your fermentation journey.

We will begin at Saturday 12th September, 10:30am at Wharekai - 298 Whitemans Valley Road.

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Mangaroa Men's Circle-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Mangaroa Men's Circle
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms and BROS for an evening of brotherhood.

BROS is an organisation focused on wellbeing and connection for men in Aotearoa New Zealand, hosting events around the country of all sizes. The mission for BROS is to gather more men around more fires. Our men's circles are the entry point. Sitting around the fire like we have done for thousands of years. To listen, speak, and be together Casual, easygoing conversation about what's real in our lives.

This space is open for all men. The invitation is to come along and share where you are at in your life, and hear the same from other men. 

We will begin at Tue 25th August | 7:00pm at 7 Whitemans Valley Road

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Somatic Breathwork Journey-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Somatic Breathwork Journey
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for Somatic Breathwork Journey —  Tue 22nd September | 6:00PM - 7:30PM

Join Amy Webber and Mangaroa Farms for a journey into your breath. Somatic Breathwork™ is a full embodiment experience designed to help you release stress, trauma, emotions and stuck energy from the body. This powerful modality uses your own breath to shed layers that no longer serve you, creating space for meaningful change in your life.

Through consciously connected breathing patterns, you'll tap into your body's innate wisdom to discover areas needing clearing. The immersive musical experience may bring forth cathartic releases—laughing, moving, crying, or shaking—all welcome expressions that help move pent-up energy through your system.

In the second half of our journey, we'll shift to a gentler breathing technique, helping you reconnect with your true self. Together, we'll use the breath to envision how you want to show up in the world, the changes you wish to make, and gain clarity on living your best life.

We will begin at Tue 22nd Sep | 6:00pm at 298 Whitemans Valley Road (Wharekai/Yurt)

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Foraging with Earth School Aotearoa | Spring has Sprung-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Foraging with Earth School Aotearoa | Spring has Sprung
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join the Earth School Aotearoa theme for a wild forage walk, timed with the season . We are big believers in learning with our Children, be it adult ones, or younger, so this walk is priced per family, not per person. Come as one, or come as many and come for a wild forage walk looking at the early spring foraging, explore fresh roots and and a range of medicinal and edible plants. The walk is pram friendly, and will be about 1 hour.

Price is per family.

Please park in the paddock beside the shop and meet under the farm shop shelter.

Wet weather. We will notify if we need to cancel within 48 hours, if the weather is too wet we have alternative locations and we may choose to make food from foraged plants instead. However if it’s too wet and cold we will likely cancel and you can join the following month. Please email hannah@earthschool.nz for any questions.

id: Sourdough Bread Baking Workshop-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Sourdough Bread Baking Workshop
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for an afternoon in the kitchen with Doris Zuur, who has been baking the slow way for decades. Rye sourdoughs raised on a living starter, wholemeal loaves that rise through an afternoon, Swiss Zopf plaited by hand, focaccia, and a fermented buckwheat loaf for those who can't eat wheat. Her bread is the kind that fills a house with its smell and a table with quiet conversation.

Spend an afternoon with her in our kitchen. You'll mix, knead, plait and bake alongside her. You'll learn how to keep a starter alive, how to read a dough by touch, and the small decisions (temperature, time, gusto) that turn flour and water into a good loaf.

You'll leave with:
- A jar of living starter to take home
- A warm loaf from the oven
- Doris's full recipe collection (rye sourdough, wholemeal, Swiss Zopf, fermented buckwheat, focaccia, Oaties)
- Her "0800 bread helpline" for when you need a hand at home

Afternoon tea included. Bring a clean glass jar with a lid, an apron, and a willingness to slow down.

We will begin at Sat 17th October | 10:00am at 298 Whitemans Valley Road (Wharekai/Yurt).

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org
